from gtools.logratio2foldchange import logratio2foldchange


def flat(x):
    if x is None:
        return "null"
    array = np.asarray(x)
    if array.size == 0:
        return ""

    def fmt(v):
        value = float(np.real(v))
        if math.isnan(value):
            return "NA"
        if math.isinf(value):
            return "Inf" if value > 0 else "-Inf"
        return format(value, ".16g")

    b = np.arange(21, 0, -1)
    f = foldchange(a, b)
    # foldchange2logratio is not translated; mirror R for the doc round-trip only.
    retval = np.where(f < 0, 1.0 / -f, f)
    lr = np.log2(retval)
    doc = logratio2foldchange(lr)
    edge = logratio2foldchange(

            np.asarray(half, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1),

            np.asarray(recycle, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1),
